author: Vector Anomaly Team
description: A declarative space-wagon campaign pack: protect a convoy, manage energy supplies, survive hostile planets, and try not to lose the crew to space dysentery.

options.description: Controls how often route events ask the player to trade safety for supplies.
Keeps the signature status effect in the route event pool.

gamemodes.description: Campaign-mode rules retuned into a physics convoy where the mother planet is the wagon and energy credits are food, fuel, medicine, and ammunition.

campaigns.description: A five-leg route that turns campaign waves into travel days, convoy repairs, barter stops, hostile planet guns, and gravity-heavy survival choices.

mission_packs.description: Cataloged route events for a future day-by-day trail director. Each event should resolve through gravity, momentum, energy spending, or escort positioning.

status_effects.description: The classic trail disaster, rebuilt as a bounded convoy-management status effect instead of random instant failure.
A mild travel sickness that nudges the player toward risky physics objectives to recover supplies.

enemy_packs.description: Enemy pack for space-bandit ambushes that pressure escorts and the mother planet instead of only chasing the player.

planet_packs.description: A planet pack for barter-or-fight stops, including hostile gun platforms and non-hostile trading outposts.

challenge_cards.description: Start the trail with fewer energy credits and stronger gravity rewards; a future director can convert this into a community challenge modifier.

creator_notes.note: This pack is intentionally declarative. The existing campaign mode provides the playable bridge today; future trusted directors can consume the route-day, status, barter, and convoy fields without executing arbitrary scripts.
